title: Abstract ODD/oddkit out of klappy.dev rather than reorganize the whole repo
content: Goal locked: let non-klappy users (Tim, Ian, others) adopt oddkit without inheriting klappy's voice, story, or software framing, and without disrupting klappy.dev (the daily driver). Approach is extraction of a universal core, not full reorganization.

title: oddkit is already a separate repo; klappy.dev is the knowledge base the Worker reads
content: README states klappy/oddkit is the engine and klappy.dev is 'the fuel'; the Worker fetches canon from raw.githubusercontent.com/klappy/klappy.dev/main at runtime. So the bifurcation is about splitting the knowledge base, and the engine is already gone.

title: Full tree: 769 files, ~24MB; 16.8MB apocrypha PDF and 152 dead-infra files dominate weight
content: canon/apocrypha PDF is ~70% of repo bytes. docs/archive holds 152 files of a previous website/compile/attempt pipeline plus product experiments. The catalog index was ~6 weeks stale and omitted recent canon/methods files; the git tree is the source of truth.

title: The split is file-level, not folder-level: law and case-files interleave inside canon folders
content: Inside canon/constraints, canon/methods, canon/principles, the universal rule and klappy's working-out of that rule sit side by side. This is why detangling felt hard. Whole-folder moves would either over-ship or leak proprietary R&D.

title: Primary constraint is serving non-klappy users; secondary is protecting proprietary
content: PRIMARY: minimal, universal, un-opinionated governance usable without software-development focus, for Tim/Ian/others. SECONDARY: keep proprietary methodology R&D, voice, story, and substrate strategy out of the public core. Inclusion test: a file is core only if a non-klappy user needs it to understand ODD, bootstrap oddkit against their own repo, and have governance function.

title: Destinations: outcomes-driven-development (core), oddkit (tool), klappy.dev (overlay); privacy deferred
content: New public repo outcomes-driven-development holds core governance/canon; oddkit absorbs docs/oddkit and tool governance; klappy.dev stays public as the personal overlay and demonstration. Core must not depend on overlay; cross-links allowed and may dead-end. Ship public now; privatize later if oddkit gains private-repo support.

title: Punt the DEAD bucket: docs/archive and the apocrypha PDF stay archived, untouched
content: Operator: 'Let's punt on Dead. I like the idea, it's an extension of the archive I started.' The old infra graveyard and the PDF remain in klappy.dev; no effort spent moving them.

title: Gate exploration->planning PASSED (problem_defined + constraints_reviewed)
content: First gate returned NOT_READY: problem statement undefined. After the operator named the primary constraint (serve Tim/Ian without software focus) and the disposition of the ambiguous piles, the re-run gate PASSED 2/2.

title: Full classification produced: 139 core / 104 tool / 371 personal / 155 archived of 769 files
content: Built from the live git tree (not the stale catalog) using frontmatter audience/tags/governs/derives_from plus titles. Manifest enumerates the movers and summarizes the stays; 29 files flagged as genuine judgment calls plus three cross-cutting forks.

title: 'Development' in ODD is a vertical label; the universal layer is the epistemic kernel
content: The domain-applicability test: only what works for ANY AI use is truly universal. canon/principles/kiss-simplicity-is-the-ceiling proves it — the same ten oddkit actions serve a 400+-doc software canon and a 26-doc oral-theology corpus unchanged. ODD's substance is universal dressed in software vocabulary; the genuinely dev-only residue is thin (odd-compared, PoC/Pilot/Prod naming).

title: TruthKit = harness + TruthKit-KB; the KB is ODD with software vocabulary removed
content: TruthKit already exists in canon as the harness layer (context-window-level enforcement; 'the harness requires'). TruthKit-KB is the minimal universal canon the harness reads. Engine:fuel :: harness:knowledgebase, mirroring oddkit:klappy.dev. So TruthKit-KB is not a separate artifact from ODD; it is ODD de-software-ified. One universal-canon repo, not two; ODD likely persists as the human-facing teaching name.

title: Observe once (audit), then act once; first extraction is TruthKit-KB, ODD-repo is a byproduct
content: Because TruthKit-KB subset ODD, do the distill first; the software-flavored outcomes-driven-development repo is kernel plus a thin vertical overlay. The two extractions (separation vs distillation) are different operations and must not be combined in one pass. The audit is the shared, non-destructive prerequisite.

title: Frontmatter-routed extraction: tag movers with target_repo; untagged = stays; defer universality
content: Put the routing in the document so the eventual move is search-and-copy. target_repo quoted-string enum. universality (universal vs software-clothing, the TruthKit-KB seed) is a second pass requiring the ODD spine read.

title: Challenge surfaced: Worker indexes only ~6 frontmatter fields; new field not searchable via oddkit
content: docs/planning/oddkit-full-frontmatter-and-drift-audit: the Worker cherry-picks a fixed field subset. So target_repo will not be found by oddkit_search unless Worker indexing is extended; 'search and copy' means git grep. frontmatter-validation-before-merge: broken frontmatter blanks the renderer in production. 'scope' is overloaded in this canon (scoped-truth, scope-over-folders).

title: Revised plan: tag ~232 movers only; field is target_repo; contested -> undecided; bundle schema+validator+tests
content: Tag movers only (138 core + 94 tool md), not all 683 (keeps the PR reviewable; untagged=stays honors meaning-must-not-depend-on-path via a default rule). Rename field scope->target_repo. Contested 29 files + 3 forks tagged 'undecided'. Same PR carries schema addition, validate-frontmatter.py allowlist, and test fixtures. Branch scope-audit, not main. Search via git grep, not oddkit. universality deferred.

content: Persisted: journal/2026-06-09-odd-truthkit-bifurcation-and-scope-audit.tsv (this file); canon/decisions/DR-20260609-0001-odd-truthkit-bifurcation.md; odd/handoffs/2026-06-09-scope-audit-execution.md. Encode is a receipt that crystallization happened; content lives in those artifacts.

content: Writing-vertical cluster (lean klappy.dev), vodka/oddkit-architecture principles (split core vs oddkit), and the AGENTS.md split (creed->core, MCP->oddkit). These are tagged 'undecided' until resolved.

content: Read the ODD spine (manifesto, contract, maturity, use-only-what-hurts, terminology, prompt-architecture, odd-compared, gate/challenge/encode definitions); tag each claim universal vs software-clothing. Output is the TruthKit-KB seed list plus the re-voicing edit list.
